scientific_question: Can a causal Lyapunov strategic-clock controller recover synchronous policy-path quality under unknown Markov-modulated actor availability at matched arrivals?

mandatory_gates.G1_validity: all finite, identical arrival/noise streams, no future-arrival access, and exact resource ledger
mandatory_gates.G2_raw_headroom: median raw-to-synchronous normalized AUC loss in the primary population is at least 0.05
mandatory_gates.G3_recovery: median Lyapunov recovery of raw-to-synchronous AUC loss is at least 0.50
mandatory_gates.G4_strong_baseline: median additional recovery over the strongest causal non-Lyapunov baseline is at least 0.10 of raw-to-synchronous loss
mandatory_gates.G5_directionality: Lyapunov is strictly better than the strongest causal non-Lyapunov baseline in at least 0.60 of headroom-active cells
mandatory_gates.G6_homogeneous_control: absolute normalized AUC loss versus the best control baseline is at most 0.01
mandatory_gates.G7_single_basin_control: absolute normalized AUC loss versus the best control baseline is at most 0.01
mandatory_gates.G8_nontriviality: update masses differ from count-only debt in at least 0.10 of primary events and the performance term is active
mandatory_gates.G9_queue_feasibility: no update exceeds maximum mass and declared feasible cells have sublinear terminal debt

stopping_rule: Any failed mandatory gate closes strategic-clock equalization as an ICML mainline; do not alter populations, thresholds, baselines, or seeds after outcomes.
